steps.en: Start one SIE server (or the Docker image that matches your GPU and model bundle)
steps.zh: 起一个 SIE 服务（或按显卡和模型包选对应镜像）

steps.en: Call it with a catalog model name per request: embed, rerank or extract
steps.zh: 每次调用写上目录里的模型名：做向量、重排或抽取

steps.en: On a model's first call, downloads its weights from Hugging Face and loads it
steps.zh: 某个模型第一次被调用时，从 Hugging Face 下权重并加载

steps.en: Batches concurrent requests by token count and runs them on the GPU
steps.zh: 按 token 数把并发请求拼成批，送上 GPU 跑

steps.en: Keeps several models resident and evicts the least recently used when memory runs short
steps.zh: 多个模型同时常驻，显存不够时踢掉最久没用的

value.en: Every small model an agent pipeline needs sits behind one API — no separate server per embedder, reranker, OCR or guard model
value.zh: 一条 agent 流水线要用的小模型都在同一个 API 后面，不用给向量、重排、OCR、审核模型各起一个服务

sources: https://github.com/superlinked/sie#quickstart (pip install "sie-server[local]" && sie-server serve; client.encode / client.score / client.extract; first call downloads weights)
https://github.com/superlinked/sie/blob/main/packages/sie_server/README.md (multi-model serving with LRU eviction, token-based dynamic batching)
